learning_outcomes.text: Define the basic concepts of production engineering.
Classify the most important manufacturing processes for processing metals and plastics with regard to their process characteristics and limits as well as their advantages and disadvantages.
Possess the ability to select suitable manufacturing processes for different tasks and to describe the respective processes.

Be able to determine process-specific characteristic values, competently evaluate them and use the results obtained to assess the various manufacturing processes against each other with regard to their advantages and disadvantages.
Know the essential basics in the field of assembly technology and be able to evaluate and estimate the economic and organizational framework conditions of assembly concepts.

syllabus_topics: Injection Molding and Extrusion of Plastics
Machining with Geometrically Defined Cutting Edge
Machining with Geometrically Undefined Cutting Edge
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded for a successfully passed module examination. The grading's importance for the final grade is according to the study and examination regulations.
